department: Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
text:
PM-PRANAM: Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment and Amelioration of Mother Earth promoting alternative and bio-fertilizer adoption among agricultural households.

Category: Agriculture & Environment
Department: Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
Scope: All
Benefits: Financial incentives for adopting natural and bio-fertilizers, Soil fertility restoration grants and agricultural input subsidies, Reduced cost of cultivation through balanced nutrient management

department: Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
text:
PM-PRANAM - Eligibility Requirements:

• Farmer or agricultural household actively cultivating agricultural land
• Willingness to adopt organic or alternative bio-nutrients
• Registered landholding or sharecropper agreement

department: Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
text:
PM-PRANAM - How to Apply:

Required Documents:
• land record
• soil health card
• bank account proof

Application Steps:
1. Register via state agriculture department or local Krishi Vigyan Kendra
2. Submit soil testing report and landholding details
3. Receive certified bio-fertilizers and direct financial incentive

department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
text:
PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY): Flagship scheme for focused and sustainable development of the fisheries sector and welfare of traditional fishers and fish farmers.

Category: Fisheries & Animal Husbandry
Department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
Scope: All
Benefits: Up to 60% capital subsidy for women/SC/ST fishers and 40% for general category, Support for motorized boats, deep-sea fishing gear, biofloc and recirculatory aquaculture systems, Livelihood and nutritional support for fishers during fishing ban periods

department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
text:
PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) - Eligibility Requirements:

• Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, or members of fisheries cooperatives/SHGs
• Possession of water bodies (owned/leased) or registered fishing vessel
• Active engagement in freshwater, brackish water, or marine fishing

department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
text:
PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) - How to Apply:

Required Documents:
• identity proof
• fisherman registration certificate
• bank account proof
• land or waterbody lease record

Application Steps:
1. Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR) to the District Fisheries Officer
2. Verification by District Level Committee (DLC)
3. State approval and subsidy credit via Direct Benefit Transfer

text:
National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM): Central sector mission to promote scientific beekeeping, increase crop pollination, and provide supplementary livelihood income to rural families.

Category: Agriculture & Livelihood
Department: National Bee Board, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
Scope: All
Benefits: Subsidies up to 80% for bee colonies, modern bee boxes, and honey extraction equipment, Custom hiring centers and testing lab support for beekeepers, Direct market access via Madhu Kranti portal with trace back authentication

text:

• Completion of basic scientific beekeeping orientation or training
• Designated apiary site or agricultural land for box placement

department: National Bee Board, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

2. Select approved bee manufacturer and equipment package
3. Inspection and direct subsidy transfer to beneficiary account

department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
text:
SVAMITVA Scheme: Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas to provide rural citizens with official digitized Property Cards (Sampatti Card).

Category: Rural Property & Governance
Department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
Scope: All
Benefits: Issuance of legal, geo-referenced Property Card (Sampatti Patrika), Financial monetization of rural residential property to secure institutional bank loans, Minimization of rural property boundary disputes with Survey of India drone accuracy

department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
text:
SVAMITVA Scheme - Eligibility Requirements:

• Owners of residential properties in rural Abadi (inhabited) areas of surveyed villages
• Citizens residing in notification-notified gram panchayats

department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
text:
SVAMITVA Scheme - How to Apply:

Required Documents:
• identity proof
• panchayat property tax receipt or family record
• aadhaar

Application Steps:
1. Drone flying conducted by Survey of India in coordination with Gram Panchayat
2. Ground verification of spatial property boundaries and objection redressal
3. Distribution of digital Property Card via Digilocker and physical registry
